$comment: Effect packs by Binbun (the owner bought the full editions). tools/content/prepare-vfx.mjs reads each Godot 4 pack (its scenes, materials and textures) and writes what the game draws: the effects' settings as JSON (`file`.json, from the pack's `dir`) and any pictures they sample, in packages/client/public/vfx (recorded in content/vfx.lock.json); only the effects `map` below names (and a pack's `keep`) are written. The packs themselves are never committed. `map` says which effect plays where; tools/content/vfx-map.mjs turns it into packages/client/src/game/fxMap.generated.ts (content:check fails when that is stale or names an effect that isn't shipped).

map.$comment: Effects by use. An effect is { pack, effect, scale } (pack: a pack's `file`, public/vfx/<file>.json: hit_fx, explosion_fx, electric_fx …). Lookups fall back from the most specific key to `default`.

muzzle.$comment: Muzzle flash by weapon family (WeaponDefinition.family; a weapon's own view.muzzle wins): effects of public/vfx/muzzle_flash.json. `projectile`: launchers with no family; `pellets`: other multi-pellet guns; `heavy`: other guns of 60+ damage.

surfaces.$comment: What a round hit, read from the level: words matched (in order) against the prop model, the tile and theme, or a free block's material. Terrain is dirt; anything unmatched is stone.

impacts.$comment: A round hitting a surface: the hole, sparks and dust drawn in house (impactVisuals.ts) as set here, and an optional Binbun accent played on top (minor: dropped when many effects are playing, and past `accentRange` metres from the camera).

weaponImpacts.$comment: Where a weapon's rounds land with their own effect, by weapon id or projectile visual (in place of the surface accent).

explosions.$comment: By weapon id first (the explode event's `w`), then its projectile visual, then the kind (barrel, trap, bomb, vehicle, air: a blast with no ground under it). Scale is per metre of blast radius.

gameplay.$comment: Moments of play: pickups (by item kind: pickup.<kind>), spawns, portals, jump pads, traps (trap.<type>) and ziplines. Minor effects: dropped when many effects are playing.

arcs.$comment: Lightning (the `arc` event): a bolt laid along each jump (`zap`: its tube stretched to the jump, rooted where it lands; `width` scales its thickness; `speed` fits the pack's 0.6 s bolt to the game's 0.1-0.15 s between arcs) and a crackle where the last one lands (`hit`, minor). By who made it: an arc sentry (`mount`, in its violet), an electric fence (`fence`) or a gun (`default`: the Arc Caster).

lasting.$comment: Effects that last while something is so (started and stopped by the game; at most a few at once by graphics quality, the nearest first). charge.<mount>: an arc sentry winding up and holding its lock (scale per metre of its drawn charge ball). fire.zone: a burning patch (molotov, flamethrower, flare, lit oil; scale per metre of its radius, one fire per ~1.5 m of it). fire.vehicle / fire.wreck: a burning vehicle and the wreck smouldering (scale per metre of its size). fire.flare: a flare burning in flight or where it stuck. fire.trap: a flame trap's jet (laid along it).
